_why: This repo wrote the same vertical under several spellings (uscis, uscis_medical,
uscis-medical; pi, personal_injury, personal-injury) into the files other systems
read: the promotion-candidates feed, the release-candidate queue, the fanout
release files and the citation runway. local-guides-generator keeps the alias
table that maps them (data/contracts/velocity_vertical_aliases.json there), and
silently dropped every candidate whose spelling it did not know.
This file mirrors that table. canonical_ids is the only vocabulary this repo
may EMIT; aliases are accepted on INPUT and resolved by
build if an emitted file carries any value outside canonical_ids.
Internal source records (content/_live/pages.json and friends) still key personal
injury as personal_injury; that is a source vocabulary, normalized at the emit
